svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Demo front page (Bin Wall)
svg.desc: Front page of the public demo deployment: what the tool does, Log in, Create account and Demo version, a bin wall with one bin lifted to a best location with its reason, and four panels following part 4410281 from its export row to the printed move list.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads your warehouse exports and
suggests which parts to move where. You decide each one.
Demo version skips the login and opens the app with a demo account.
Apply it, or keep in place
Nothing changes until you apply it.
